body.name: Explicit rational standard-form SOCP encoding
body.construction: Introduce nonnegative slacks for every scalar inequality, split every free scalar into positive and negative parts, encode each predictor norm by \((u_{jh},x_j-\sum_iw_{jh,i}x_i)\in\mathcal L_{p+1}\), and encode each noise norm by \((v_{jh},R_Qa_{jh}(w))\in\mathcal L_{|\mathcal C|+1}\). For each \(s\), the resulting record is \(P_s:\min c_s^{\top}y\) subject to \(B_sy=d_s\) and \(y\in\mathcal K_s\), with \(B_s,d_s,c_s\) rational and \(\mathcal K_s\) an explicitly ordered product of nonnegative orthants, Lorentz cones \(\mathcal L_q=\{(t,z):\lVert z\rVert_2\le t\}\), and zero cones. Its objective value is \(\Gamma_s\).
